Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Printing Solutions specializes in high-quality commercial printing and binding services, including digital printing, offset printing, and custom binding for a variety of industries. Our operations involve the use of advanced printing technology and equipment to produce brochures, catalogs, and promotional materials. We prioritize safety by implementing strict fire and safety protocols, including regular inspections of our fire suppression systems and safe storage of flammable materials. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional service while maintaining a safe working environment.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
Losses were incurred on two separate occasions: 

1. On March 15, 2022, a fire broke out in the production area due to a malfunctioning printing press, resulting in property damage estimated at $2,000. The incident is currently under review for potential recovery through our existing fire insurance policy. 

2. On July 10, 2023, we experienced water damage to our storage area after a heavy rain caused a roof leak, leading to the ruin of several thousand dollars’ worth of printed materials. The total loss for this incident is estimated at $1,500, and we are in the process of filing a claim with our insurance provider. 

Both incidents underscore the importance of rigorous safety measures in our operations.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe with UL 72 certification; fire-resistant, rated for high-risk environments, equipped with an electronic lock and continuous monitoring system.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the property, monitored by a central station alarm system. Additionally, we employ two watchpersons during night shifts to ensure safety and security of the premises.
